name: Athena Balanced Growth Portfolio
investment_objective: Diversified long-term growth with meaningful fixed income ballast and a small defensive reserve.
strategy_description: Diversified long-term growth portfolio with broad equity exposure, fixed income ballast, small alternative allocation and cash reserve.
ips_summary: Target roughly 60% equities, 30% fixed income, 5% alternatives and 5% cash while avoiding excessive single-name concentration.
market_data_coverage: All holdings use deterministic Market Data demo price histories.
fixed_income_assumptions: BND and IEF use demo duration, modified duration and DV01 assumptions.
commentary_focus: Diversification across broad equity, international equity, fixed income, gold and cash.
Moderate equity risk with manageable concentration.
Fixed income provides stabilizing ballast but adds rate sensitivity.
